reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: West Virginia
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is the constable an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?

    Source statute provided:
    WV Code  55-3A-3 (2021)
*/

% ----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% ----------------------------

scenario_state(west_virginia).
scenario_year(2021).
scenario_officer(constable).
scenario_action(execute_writ_of_eviction).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario statement holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(west_virginia),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_officer(constable),
    scenario_action(execute_writ_of_eviction).

% ----------------------------
% Statute translations (WV Code  55-3A-3 (2021))
% ----------------------------

/*
  55-3A-3(a): If no appearance, answer, or other responsive pleading is filed,
  the court shall enter an order granting immediate possession to the landlord.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_a_immediate_possession_required(Appearance, Answer, ResponsivePleading, Required) :-
    ( Appearance = no, Answer = no, ResponsivePleading = no ->
        Required = yes
    ;
        Required = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(b): For rent arrearage petitions, if tenant answers raising defense of
  landlord breach of material covenant, court shall proceed to a hearing on such issues.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_b_hearing_required(PetitionType, AnswerRaisesDefense, Required) :-
    ( PetitionType = arrearage_in_rent, AnswerRaisesDefense = yes ->
        Required = yes
    ;
        Required = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(c): For breach-by-tenant or damage petitions, if tenant answers raising defenses,
  court shall proceed to a hearing on such issues.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_c_hearing_required(PetitionType, AnswerRaisesDefenses, Required) :-
    ( (PetitionType = breach_by_tenant ; PetitionType = damage_to_property),
      AnswerRaisesDefenses = yes ->
        Required = yes
    ;
        Required = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(d): Continuances shall be for cause only; not a matter of right.
  If a continuance is granted upon tenant request, tenant must pay periodic rent due during continuance into court.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_d_continuance_standard(ContinuanceGranted, CauseShown, StandardSatisfied) :-
    ( ContinuanceGranted = yes, CauseShown = yes ->
        StandardSatisfied = yes
    ; ContinuanceGranted = yes, CauseShown = no ->
        StandardSatisfied = no
    ; ContinuanceGranted = no ->
        StandardSatisfied = yes
    ),
    !.

statute_55_3a_3_d_tenant_rent_payment_required_if_tenant_requested(ContinuanceGranted, RequestedByTenant, Required) :-
    ( ContinuanceGranted = yes, RequestedByTenant = yes ->
        Required = yes
    ;
        Required = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(e): At conclusion of hearing under (b) or (c), if court finds tenant in wrongful occupation,
  court shall enter an order granting immediate possession to landlord.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_e_immediate_possession_after_hearing_required(HearingUnderBC, WrongfulOccupationFound, Required) :-
    ( HearingUnderBC = yes, WrongfulOccupationFound = yes ->
        Required = yes
    ;
        Required = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(f): Court order specifies vacate time considering factors; if tenant continues beyond time,
  the sheriff shall forthwith remove the tenant (taking precautions to guard against property damage).

  This is the key enforcement designation in the provided statute.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_f_enforcement_officer(State, Year, sheriff) :-
    State = west_virginia,
    Year = 2021,
    !.

statute_55_3a_3_f_requires_order_specify_vacate_time(Required) :-
    Required = yes,
    !.

statute_55_3a_3_f_removal_duty_if_holdover(TenantContinuesBeyondTime, DutyToRemove) :-
    ( TenantContinuesBeyondTime = yes ->
        DutyToRemove = yes
    ;
        DutyToRemove = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(g): If appeal and tenant prevails, relief is monetary only; no restoration if lease expired,
  absent issue of title, retaliatory eviction, or breach of warranty. During appeal, tenant not entitled
  to remain if tenancy expired.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_g_relief_if_tenant_prevails_on_appeal(LeaseExpired, ExceptionApplies, ReliefType) :-
    ( LeaseExpired = yes, ExceptionApplies = no ->
        ReliefType = monetary_only
    ; LeaseExpired = yes, ExceptionApplies = yes ->
        ReliefType = may_restore_possession
    ; LeaseExpired = no ->
        ReliefType = may_restore_possession
    ),
    !.

statute_55_3a_3_g_tenant_entitled_to_remain_during_appeal(TenancyExpired, Entitled) :-
    ( TenancyExpired = yes ->
        Entitled = no
    ;
        Entitled = yes
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(h): If order granting possession issued and tenant fails to remove personal property by the
  specified date/time, landlord may: dispose if abandoned/garbage; remove & store (then dispose after 30 days
  under certain conditions); or leave on property (then dispose after 30 days under certain conditions).
*/
statute_55_3a_3_h_landlord_may_dispose_if_abandoned_or_garbage(TenantInformsAbandonedInWriting, IsGarbage, MayDispose) :-
    ( TenantInformsAbandonedInWriting = yes ->
        MayDispose = yes
    ; IsGarbage = yes ->
        MayDispose = yes
    ;
        MayDispose = no
    ),
    !.

statute_55_3a_3_h_may_dispose_stored_after_30_days(ThirtyDaysElapsed, StorageCostsPaid, TenantTookPossession, StorageCostsEqualValue, MayDispose) :-
    ( ThirtyDaysElapsed = yes,
      ( (StorageCostsPaid = no, TenantTookPossession = no)
      ; StorageCostsEqualValue = yes
      ) ->
        MayDispose = yes
    ;
        MayDispose = no
    ),
    !.

statute_55_3a_3_h_may_dispose_left_on_property_after_30_days(ThirtyDaysElapsed, ReasonableCostsPaid, TenantTookPossession, MayDispose) :-
    ( ThirtyDaysElapsed = yes, ReasonableCostsPaid = no, TenantTookPossession = no ->
        MayDispose = yes
    ;
        MayDispose = no
    ),
    !.

/*
  55-3A-3(i): Notwithstanding (h), if personal property worth > $300 and not removed within 30 days with required fees,
  landlord shall store up to 30 additional days if tenant/secured party informs intent to remove AND pays reasonable costs.
*/
statute_55_3a_3_i_additional_storage_required(PropertyValue, NotRemovedWithin30Days, IntentToRemoveInformed, CostsPaid, AdditionalStorageRequired) :-
    ( number(PropertyValue),
      PropertyValue > 300,
      NotRemovedWithin30Days = yes,
      IntentToRemoveInformed = yes,
      CostsPaid = yes ->
        AdditionalStorageRequired = yes
    ;
        AdditionalStorageRequired = no
    ),
    !.

% ----------------------------
% Legal reasoning predicates (derived from statute translations)
% ----------------------------

/*
  Core legal concept for this question:
  An individual is "empowered by law" (based solely on the provided statute) to execute/enforce eviction removal
  if the statute designates that officer to perform the removal.
*/
legal_empowered_to_execute_eviction_writ(State, Year, Officer) :-
    statute_55_3a_3_f_enforcement_officer(State, Year, Officer),
    !.

% ----------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
% ----------------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_officer(Officer),
    ( legal_empowered_to_execute_eviction_writ(State, Year, Officer) ->
        Result = yes
    ;
        Result = no
    ),
    !.

% ----------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the constable an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
